name: TGT Greenville Lateral
researcher_notes: Operating Texas Gas Transmission lateral missing from GEM (roster has only P0263 main line, P2518, P7794; P7802 is Tennessee Gas Mississippi Crossing, unrelated). A 2008 Federal Register notice from the FERC docket CP07-417 describes a 96.4 mile, 36 inch Greenville Lateral in Washington, Sunflower, Humphreys, Holmes and Attala Counties, Mississippi, from the Greenville compressor station to a delivery point near Kosciusko. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 pipeline projects release (sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 594) lists it as completed, in service 2009, 96.4 miles, 36 inch, 768 MMcf/d, in service date 2010-07-08 listed as release date. The EIA release is one origin; the Federal Register notice is independent. A 2007 Oil and Gas Journal article covers the draft environmental statement. Capacity 768 is stated by EIA only; the notice gives 768,000 MMBtu/d. Passes length rule: 96.4 mi is well over 15.5 mi, and the line is built. Owner spelled Texas Gas Transmission LLC; entity lookup found no exact gazetteer hit, so style is unconfirmed. Route not researched; no GIS source checked. Related completed row 'Greenville Lateral Expansion' (EIA row 633, 2010, compression only) is not new pipe and is not proposed. Endpoint Kosciusko stated in the notice and not read from a map.
